subject: [cam] payload-vcodec-prod STAGED + rehearsed: Camera on the hw encoder/decoder (vcodecd f974e33f, enc plug-in 43e3cf7d, dec plug-in 3e19b9de)
body: Host only, nothing ran in Camera. Procedure + design: gpu/hwcodec/CAMERA_INTEGRATION.md. Payloads (gpu/build/apps-20261104): payload-vcodec-prod (production: only com.nord2.vcodecd, RunAtLoad + KeepAlive{SuccessfulExit:false}, --restart-on-switch --decoder, gate run permanent, test gates/jobs/files removed, claim-hw+hwdec ON), payload-vcodec-prod-sync (A/B: synchronous encoder object), payload-vcodec-prod-nodaemon (fallback test: daemon never started). Owned list owned-vcodec-prod.json. REHEARSAL_OK for all three; also decall-install -> prod-install -> undo on the real launchd.plist (one job left, undo restores the previous Slim.videoencoder byte-identical). Command: PAYLOAD=payload-vcodec-prod GUEST=guest-vcodec.sh OWNED=$W/gpu/build/apps-20261104/owned-vcodec-prod.json timeout 900 bash autocycle/txn.sh $IMG cam1-prod (any image with the relay fix; rootfs only). Then phone.py scenario video + cam_check.py log (VERDICT line). P04 tests: N2TEST P04 PASS 8517/8517 (ASan/UBSan/-O2/TSan). Code: vt/n2hwenc_vt.c (pipeline, deferred emit on VT threads only, bounded StartSession with BUSY/restart retry, no ENC_SET before frame 0, stride repack, idle reopen), vt/n2hwenc_client.{c,h} (timeouts 400/1000/1000 ms, BUSY/RESTART codes, process-wide relay lock), vt/test/*, vt/symbols.txt, ios/build_plugins.sh (the decoder product was NEVER built before: ^SLIMRegister pattern missed DEC06; now builds with DEC05 client + mm21 + n2vt_log), stage-vcodec.sh --prod, guest-vcodec.sh plan prod, rehearse-vcodec.sh (no-probe payloads, N2_REHEARSE_DIR), new gpu/hwcodec/cam/cam_check.py.
